goal: A project configures Definition of Ready and Definition of Done checks, and missing executed evidence still blocks delivered
scenarios: a project returns its Definition of Ready and Definition of Done policy
a developer updates which Ready and Done checks the project requires
a story cannot become ready when a configured Ready check is missing
a story without executed evidence cannot transition to delivered
stale or failed required evidence still blocks delivered
a configured extra Done check such as unfinished children blocks delivered
inspecting delivery gates names the missing Ready or Done pieces
Story delivery start uses the project Ready policy
customers cannot change the project Ready or Done policy
constraints: governance certification packs are out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
